chapters.name: The Awakening
chapters.description: Learn the basics of the Singularity

steps.title: A Strange Arrow
steps.text:
You find yourself standing in the middle of a desolate town. The air is thick with tension...

A **mysterious arrow** glows faintly at your feet. You feel drawn to it — as if it's calling out to you.

steps.title: Your First Character
steps.text:
The arrow pierces through reality itself. A figure materializes before you — your first **Character**.

Characters are your fighters. Each has a **Rarity** (R, SR, SSR, UR, LR), **Types**, and **Qualities** that define how they fight.

Use `/banner pull` to summon new characters with Super Fragments.
steps.action_label: Pull your first character with `/banner pull`

steps.title: Know Your Fighter
steps.text:
Every character has stats: **HP**, **Damage**, **Speed**, **Armor**, and **Critical**.

Speed determines who attacks first. Critical chance can deal double damage. Armor reduces incoming hits.

Use `/character show` to inspect your main character's stats and abilities.

steps.title: The Test Dummy
steps.text:
Before you face real opponents, test your strength against a training dummy.

Fights are turn-based. Each turn you choose which enemy to target. Your character also has a **Special Ability** that charges over time.

Use `/fight test` to try it out!
steps.action_label: Complete a test fight with `/fight test`

steps.title: Equip for Battle
steps.text:
Items give your characters an edge. **Equipable** items boost stats permanently while worn. Some have **Active abilities** that trigger during fights.

Use `/item equip` to gear up your characters.
Use `/item use` to consume usable items like Stand Arrows.

steps.title: Daily Grind
steps.text:
The Singularity rewards those who return daily.

- `/adventure daily` — Claim fragments and items every day
- `/wormhole` — Face random enemies for loot
- `/tower` — Climb increasingly difficult floors
- `/adventure dungeon` — Explore maps and fight mobs

Consistency is key. Energy regenerates over time.
steps.action_label: Claim your first daily with `/adventure daily`

steps.title: Ready for War
steps.text:
You've learned the basics. The real challenge awaits.

- `/fight local @user` — Challenge friends
- `/fight ranked` — Climb the ranked ladder
- `/gang` — Join or create a gang for co-op raids

Here are **3 Stand Arrows** to help you on your journey. Use them with `/banner arrow` for 5 pulls each!

Good luck out there.
